description_en: Creates a command that is used to install the Security Center agent
kebab_example: aliyun sas add-install-code --group-id 8076980 --os linux --expired-date 1680257463853 --vendor-name ALIYUN --only-image false --proxy-cluster proxy_test --private-link-id 72845 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddInstallCode

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the asset group to which you want to add the asset.

You can call the [DescribeAllGroups](~~DescribeAllGroups~~) operation to query the IDs of asset groups
parameters.help_zh:
指定需要资产绑定的分组ID。
调用[DescribeAllGroups ](~~DescribeAllGroups~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en:
The operating system of the asset. Default value: linux. Valid values:

linux
windows
parameters.help_zh:
实例的操作系统。默认值为linux。取值：

linux：linux

windows：windows
parameters.name: os

parameters.help_en:
The validity period of the installation command. The value is a 13-digit timestamp.

The installation command is valid only within the validity period. An expired installation command cannot be used to install the Security Center agent
parameters.help_zh:
安装验证码有效日期。格式为13位时间戳。
安装验证码只有在有效期内才能使用。过期的安装验证码无法使用
parameters.name: expired_date

parameters.help_en:
The name of the service provider for the asset. Default value: ALIYUN.

You can call the [DescribeVendorList](~~DescribeVendorList~~) operation to query the names of service providers
parameters.help_zh:
资产的服务商名称，默认ALIYUN。

调用[DescribeVendorList](~~DescribeVendorList~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: vendor_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to create an image. Default value: false. Valid values:

false: does not create an image.
true: creates an image
parameters.help_zh:
制作镜像。默认false，取值：

false：否

true：是
parameters.name: only_image

parameters.help_en: The name of the proxy cluster
parameters.name: proxy_cluster

parameters.help_en: The ID of the PrivateLink endpoint
parameters.name: private_link_id

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
